description: Get the cover (start thumbnail) of a video. Returns {response: {active, default}}: active = the uploaded cover in use (absent when none was uploaded), default = the automatic thumbnails generated from the video. Pause and end thumbnails are NOT listed here — they are CTAs in the video's player config (panda_get_video_player_config → ctas with type 'pause' / 'end').
name: panda_get_thumbnails
title: Get Thumbnails
